# Part 5: B and NK cells

## 5.1 Parameters

```{r bnk-params}
bnk_params <- list(
  celltype_var   = "celltypes",
  donor_var      = "patient_ID",
  diagnosis_var  = "diagnosis",
  resolutions    = c(0.4, 0.8, 1.2),
  base_res       = 0.8,
  seed           = 1
)
stopifnot(!is.null(path$graphs_bnk), !is.null(path$tables_bnk))
```

### 5.1.1 Lineage definitions

```{r bnk-lineage-def}
BNK_LINEAGES <- list(
  B  = c("B-Cells", "Plasma-Cells", "Plasmablasts"),
  NK = c("NK-Cells", "NK Cells")
)

BNK_LINEAGE_QC <- list(
  B  = list(pos    = c("CD79A", "CD79B", "MS4A1", "CD19", "MZB1", "JCHAIN"),
            contam = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC", "LYZ", "CD14", "PPBP")),
  NK = list(pos    = c("KLRD1", "NKG7", "GNLY", "KLRF1", "TYROBP"),
            contam = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC", "CD79A", "MS4A1", "LYZ", "CD14"))
)
```

```{r bnk-helpers-check}
bnk_need <- c("plot_clusters", "umap_compartment_figure", "dot_compartment_figure",
```

## 5.3 Load and subset

```{r bnk-cache-check}
bnk_clustered_output <- file.path(path$objects, "08R_bnk_clustered.qs")
bnk_output <- file.path(path$objects, "08R_bnk_cells_filtered_xALD.qs")
bnk_force_recompute <- FALSE
bnk_cached <- file.exists(bnk_output) && !bnk_force_recompute
if (bnk_cached) bnk_filtered <- qread(bnk_output)
```

```{r bnk-load, eval = !bnk_cached}
bnk_obj_list <- qread(file.path(path$objects, "03R_xALD_filtered_integrated.qs"))
BNK_COMPARTMENTS <- names(bnk_obj_list)

bnk_lvl <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(bnk_obj_list, function(o)
  as.character(o@meta.data[[bnk_params$celltype_var]])))))
print(bnk_lvl)
for (lin in names(BNK_LINEAGES))
  if (!any(BNK_LINEAGES[[lin]] %in% bnk_lvl))
    stop(lin, ": none of ", toString(BNK_LINEAGES[[lin]]), " in ", bnk_params$celltype_var, " -- adjust BNK_LINEAGES in 5.2.")

bnk_spec <- expand.grid(lineage = names(BNK_LINEAGES), compartment = BNK_COMPARTMENTS,
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
bnk_cells <- purrr::pmap(bnk_spec, function(lineage, compartment) {
  o    <- bnk_obj_list[[compartment]]
  keep <- o@meta.data[[bnk_params$celltype_var]] %in% BNK_LINEAGES[[lineage]]
  o    <- subset(o, cells = colnames(o)[keep])
  o$lineage     <- lineage
  o$compartment <- compartment
  o$orig_label  <- as.character(o@meta.data[[bnk_params$celltype_var]])
  o
}) |> setNames(sprintf("%s_%s", bnk_spec$lineage, bnk_spec$compartment))
rm(bnk_obj_list); invisible(gc())
sapply(bnk_cells, ncol)
```

## 5.4 Embedding and clustering

```{r bnk-embed-cluster, eval = !bnk_cached}
set.seed(42)
bnk_cells <- lapply(bnk_cells, function(o)
  lineage_cluster(lineage_embed(o), bnk_params$resolutions, bnk_params$base_res, bnk_params$seed))
lapply(bnk_cells, function(o) table(o$seurat_clusters))
qsave(bnk_cells, bnk_clustered_output)
```

```{r bnk-purity, eval = !bnk_cached}
purrr::imap_dfr(bnk_cells, function(o, n) tibble(
  subset     = n,
  resolution = bnk_params$resolutions,
  n_clusters = sapply(bnk_params$resolutions, function(r) dplyr::n_distinct(o[[lineage_res_col(r)]][, 1])),
  purity     = sapply(bnk_params$resolutions, function(r) round(knn_purity(o, lineage_res_col(r)), 4)))) |>
  kable_save("bnk_cluster_purity", dir = path$tables_bnk,
             caption = "Clusters and kNN purity per subset and resolution")
```

```{r bnk-seed-stability, eval = !bnk_cached}
purrr::imap_dfr(bnk_cells, function(so, nm)
  lineage_seed_stability(so, bnk_params$base_res, bnk_params$seed) |> dplyr::mutate(subset = nm, .before = 1))
```

```{r bnk-cluster-umaps, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6, eval = !bnk_cached}
purrr::iwalk(bnk_cells, function(so, nm)
```

## 5.6 Labels

```{r bnk-cluster-labels, eval = !bnk_cached}
bnk_cluster_names <- list(
  B_CSF   = c(
  ),
  B_PBMC  = c(
  ),
  NK_CSF  = c(
  ),
  NK_PBMC = c(
  )
)

bnk_removed <- tibble::tribble(
  ~subset, ~seurat_clusters, ~reason
)

check_cluster_map(bnk_cells, bnk_cluster_names, bnk_removed, key = "subset", complete = FALSE)

bnk_removed |>
  dplyr::left_join(bnk_cluster_qc, by = c("subset", "seurat_clusters")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  readr::write_csv(file.path(path$tables_bnk, "bnk_cluster_review.csv"))
```

```{r bnk-apply-labels, eval = !bnk_cached}
bnk_filtered <- purrr::imap(bnk_cells, function(o, nm) {
  cl   <- as.character(o$seurat_clusters)
  drop <- cl %in% bnk_removed$seurat_clusters[bnk_removed$subset == nm]
  map  <- bnk_cluster_names[[nm]]
  todo <- setdiff(unique(cl[!drop]), names(map))
  if (length(todo)) {
    warning("Part 5: label map for ", nm, " incomplete (no label for cluster(s) ",
            toString(sort(todo)), ") -- using raw cluster IDs.", call. = FALSE)
    o$celltype <- paste0("cl", cl)
    o$labels_curated <- FALSE
  } else {
    o$celltype <- unname(map[cl])
    o$labels_curated <- TRUE
  }
  message(nm, ": removed ", sum(drop), " cells")
  if (any(drop)) o <- lineage_embed(subset(o, cells = colnames(o)[!drop]), neighbors = FALSE)
  o
})
qsave(bnk_filtered, bnk_output)
rm(bnk_cells); invisible(gc())
```

```{r bnk-celltype-counts}
BNK_COMPARTMENTS <- unique(vapply(bnk_filtered, function(o)

purrr::imap_dfr(bnk_filtered, function(o, nm)

         celltype = names(table(o$celltype)), n_cells = as.integer(table(o$celltype)))) |>
  kable_save("bnk_celltype_counts", dir = path$tables_bnk,
```

## 5.9 Composition

### 5.9.1 Differential abundance (edgeR, NB + offset)

```{r bnk-da-config}
BNK_AB_MIN_DONORS_PER_GROUP <- 2

par_ab_bnk <- list(
  label_col       = "celltype",
  donor_col       = "sample_key",
  group_col       = bnk_params$diagnosis_var,
  compartment_col = "compartment",
  strat_col       = "severity_active",
  ref_group       = "control",
  min_cells       = 5,
  min_samples     = 0.5,
  fdr             = 0.05,
  ext_totals      = NULL)
```

```{r bnk-da-fit, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
bnk_meta <- lapply(bnk_by_lineage, ab_get_meta, compartment_col = par_ab_bnk$compartment_col)

bnk_ab <- purrr::imap(bnk_by_lineage, function(objs, lin) {
  out <- list()
  for (comp in names(objs)) {
    ab <- tryCatch(build_abundance_inputs(
      bnk_meta[[lin]], compartment_col = par_ab_bnk$compartment_col, focus = comp,
      donor_col = par_ab_bnk$donor_col, group_col = par_ab_bnk$group_col,
      label_col = par_ab_bnk$label_col, strat_col = par_ab_bnk$strat_col,
      ref_group = par_ab_bnk$ref_group, min_cells = par_ab_bnk$min_cells,
      min_samples = par_ab_bnk$min_samples, ext_totals = par_ab_bnk$ext_totals),
      error = function(e) { message(lin, "/", comp, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
    if (is.null(ab)) next
    n_grp <- table(droplevels(ab$sinfo$group))
    if (length(n_grp) < 2 || any(n_grp < BNK_AB_MIN_DONORS_PER_GROUP) || nrow(ab$mat) < 2) {
      message(lin, "/", comp, ": ", paste(sprintf("%s=%d", names(n_grp), n_grp), collapse = ", "),
              " donors, ", nrow(ab$mat), " cell types -- skipped"); next
    }
    design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = ab$sinfo)
    colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
    res <- fit_ab(ab$mat, ab$sinfo, ab$totals, design,
                  coef = setdiff(colnames(design), "X.Intercept.")[1], fdr = par_ab_bnk$fdr) |>
      dplyr::arrange(FDR) |>
      dplyr::mutate(lineage = lin, compartment = comp, contrast = "xALD_vs_ctrl",
                    n_ref = as.integer(n_grp[[par_ab_bnk$ref_group]]),
                    n_test = as.integer(sum(n_grp) - n_grp[[par_ab_bnk$ref_group]]),
                    .before = 1)

    kable_save(tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(cbind(ab$mat, total = ab$totals)), "celltype"),
               sprintf("bnk_da_counts_%s_%s", tolower(lin), comp), dir = path$tables_bnk,
               caption = sprintf("%s, %s: cells per donor", BNK_LINEAGE_TITLE[[lin]], comp)) |>
      print()
    cmp <- ab_compositional(ab, res) %>% dplyr::mutate(lineage = lin, compartment = comp, .before = 1)
    fig <- ab_res_for_figure(res, cmp)
    print(plot_ab_figure(
      ab$long, fig$res, ab$totals,
      pal = umap_palette_for(bnk_umap_figs[[lin]], comp, ab$long$celltype),
      title_a = "Per-donor composition", title_b_prefix = paste0("X-ALD vs control, ", fig$method),
      y_lab = sprintf("proportion of %s %s", comp, BNK_LINEAGE_TITLE[[lin]]),
      fdr = par_ab_bnk$fdr, x_lab = fig$x_lab, ci_label = fig$ci_label,
      out_file = file.path(path$graphs_bnk,
                           sprintf("bnk_da_%s_%s_%s.png", fig$method, tolower(lin), comp))))
    out[[comp]] <- list(inputs = ab, res = res, comp = cmp, res_fig = fig$res,
                        method = fig$method, x_lab = fig$x_lab)
  }
  if (length(out))
    store_figure_panels(BNK_FIG_LEVEL[[lin]], "abundance", abundance_figure_panels(
      out, umap_fig = bnk_umap_figs[[lin]], ref_group = par_ab_bnk$ref_group,
      contrast = "X-ALD vs control", fdr = par_ab_bnk$fdr,
      y_lab = paste("proportion of", BNK_LINEAGE_TITLE[[lin]])))
  out
})

bnk_da_res <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bnk_ab, function(l) dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(l, `[[`, "res"))))
readr::write_csv(bnk_da_res, file.path(path$tables_bnk, "bnk_da_edger_all.csv"))
kable_save(
  dplyr::select(bnk_da_res, lineage, compartment, celltype,
                logFC, ci_lo, ci_hi, PValue, FDR, n_ref, n_test),
  "bnk_da_edger_summary", dir = path$tables_bnk,
  digits = 3, caption = "X-ALD vs control: log2 FC in proportion")
```

### 5.9.5 CSF vs PBMC, paired donors

```{r bnk-paired, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 7}
bnk_paired <- purrr::imap(bnk_by_lineage, function(objs, lin) {
  x <- ab_paired_compartment(objs, "celltype")
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  print(knitr::kable(x$res %>% dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(median_CSF, median_PBMC), ~ round(100 * .x, 2)),
                                             log2OR = round(log2OR, 2)) %>%
                       dplyr::select(celltype, `%CSF` = median_CSF, `%PBMC` = median_PBMC, log2OR, p.value, padj),
                     digits = 4, caption = paste(BNK_LINEAGE_TITLE[[lin]], ": CSF vs PBMC")))
  print(x$propeller)
  readr::write_csv(x$by_dx, file.path(path$tables_bnk, sprintf("bnk_csf_vs_pbmc_%s.csv", tolower(lin))))
  p <- plot_ab_paired(x, what = BNK_LINEAGE_TITLE[[lin]], stem = sprintf("bnk_csf_vs_pbmc_%s", tolower(lin)),
                      dir = path$graphs_bnk)
  print(p$forest); print(p$pairs)

})
```

```{r bnk-deg-run}
}))
```

## 5.13 Intrathecal Ig production

```{r bnk-ig-setup}
ISOTYPE_GENES <- list(
  IgM = "IGHM", IgD = "IGHD",
  IgG = c("IGHG1", "IGHG2", "IGHG3", "IGHG4"),
  IgA = c("IGHA1", "IGHA2"), IgE = "IGHE")
LIGHT_GENES <- list(kappa = "IGKC",
                    lambda = c("IGLC1", "IGLC2", "IGLC3", "IGLC7"))

ig_counts <- function(obj, sets) {
  cts <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  out <- sapply(sets, function(g) {
    g <- intersect(g, rownames(cts))
    if (!length(g)) return(rep(0, ncol(cts)))
    Matrix::colSums(cts[g, , drop = FALSE])
  })
  matrix(out, nrow = ncol(cts), dimnames = list(colnames(cts), names(sets)))
}

assign_isotype <- function(obj, min_counts = 10, min_frac = 0.6) {
  m   <- ig_counts(obj, ISOTYPE_GENES)
  tot <- rowSums(m)
  top <- max.col(m, ties.method = "first")
  frac <- ifelse(tot > 0, m[cbind(seq_len(nrow(m)), top)] / tot, NA_real_)
  ok  <- tot >= min_counts & !is.na(frac) & frac >= min_frac

  lm_ <- ig_counts(obj, LIGHT_GENES)
  lt  <- rowSums(lm_)

  obj$ig_total     <- tot
  obj$ig_frac_top  <- frac
  obj$isotype      <- ifelse(ok, colnames(m)[top], NA_character_)
  obj$light_total  <- lt
  obj$light_chain  <- ifelse(lt >= min_counts,
                             ifelse(lm_[, "kappa"] > lm_[, "lambda"], "kappa", "lambda"),
                             NA_character_)
  obj
}

bnk_ig <- lapply(bnk_filtered, assign_isotype)

BNK_COMPS  <- BNK_COMPARTMENTS
BNK_DON_RE <- paste0("_(", paste(BNK_COMPS, collapse = "|"), ")$")

PB_PATTERN    <- "Plasmablast|Plasma"
NAIVE_PATTERN <- "Naive|Transitional|B-Cell"

ig_label_col <- function(o) {
  for (cl in c("celltype", "orig_label")) {
    v <- if (cl %in% colnames(o[[]])) as.character(o[[cl, drop = TRUE]]) else NULL
    if (!is.null(v) && any(grepl(paste(PB_PATTERN, NAIVE_PATTERN, sep = "|"), v)))
      return(cl)
  }
  NA_character_
}

ig_labels_of <- function(o) {
  cl <- ig_label_col(o)
  if (is.na(cl)) rep(NA_character_, ncol(o)) else as.character(o[[cl, drop = TRUE]])
}

bnk_lab_cols <- vapply(bnk_ig[grep("^B_", names(bnk_ig))], ig_label_col, character(1))
message("Label column per B subset: ",
        paste(sprintf("%s=%s", names(bnk_lab_cols), bnk_lab_cols), collapse = ", "))
```

#### Readout 1 - isotype distribution, CSF vs blood of the same donor

```{r bnk-ig-isotype, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
IG_MIN_ASSIGNED <- 10

isotype_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(bnk_ig[grep("^B_", names(bnk_ig))], function(o, nm) {
  tibble(compartment = unique(as.character(o$compartment)),
         donor_raw   = as.character(o[[bnk_params$donor_var, drop = TRUE]]),
         group       = as.character(o[[bnk_params$diagnosis_var, drop = TRUE]]),
         isotype     = o$isotype)
}) |>
  dplyr::mutate(donor = sub(BNK_DON_RE, "", donor_raw)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(isotype)) |>
  dplyr::count(compartment, donor, group, isotype, name = "n") |>
  tidyr::complete(tidyr::nesting(compartment, donor, group),
                  isotype = names(ISOTYPE_GENES), fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(compartment, donor) |>
  dplyr::mutate(n_donor = sum(n), pct = 100 * n / n_donor) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

isotype_yield <- isotype_long |>
  dplyr::distinct(compartment, donor, group, n_donor) |>
  dplyr::arrange(compartment, dplyr::desc(n_donor))
cat("Assigned B cells per donor x compartment",
    sprintf("(threshold %d):\n", IG_MIN_ASSIGNED))
print(as.data.frame(isotype_yield))
cat(sprintf("  above threshold: %d of %d\n",
            sum(isotype_yield$n_donor >= IG_MIN_ASSIGNED), nrow(isotype_yield)))

isotype_tab <- dplyr::filter(isotype_long, n_donor >= IG_MIN_ASSIGNED)
readr::write_csv(isotype_tab, file.path(path$tables_bnk, "bnk_ig_isotype_per_donor.csv"))

bnk_comps_ok <- sort(unique(isotype_tab$compartment))
isotype_paired <- NULL

if (!nrow(isotype_tab)) {
  message("Readout 1: no donor reaches ", IG_MIN_ASSIGNED,
          " assigned B cells. In order: (1) check ig-ambient -- does the ",
          "assignment hold at all? (2) lower IG_MIN_ASSIGNED and report the ",
          "uncertainty; (3) loosen min_counts/min_frac in assign_isotype(), ",
          "which lets ambient signal in.")
} else if (length(bnk_comps_ok) < 2) {
  message("Readout 1: only compartment '", bnk_comps_ok,
          "' clears the threshold -- no paired comparison possible. Report ",
          "this rather than working around it.")
} else {
  bnk_csf_comp <- if ("CSF" %in% bnk_comps_ok) "CSF" else bnk_comps_ok[1]
  bnk_ref_comp <- setdiff(bnk_comps_ok, bnk_csf_comp)[1]

  bnk_wide <- isotype_tab |>
    dplyr::select(donor, group, isotype, compartment, pct) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = compartment, values_from = pct) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[bnk_csf_comp]]), !is.na(.data[[bnk_ref_comp]]))

  if (!nrow(bnk_wide)) {
    message("Readout 1: no donor has BOTH compartments above the threshold ",
            "-- no paired test possible.")
  } else {
    isotype_paired <- bnk_wide |>
      dplyr::mutate(.csf = .data[[bnk_csf_comp]], .ref = .data[[bnk_ref_comp]]) |>
      dplyr::group_by(group, isotype) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_pairs  = dplyr::n(),
        med_CSF  = stats::median(.csf), med_ref = stats::median(.ref),
        delta    = stats::median(.csf - .ref),
        p_paired = if (dplyr::n() >= 4)
          suppressWarnings(stats::wilcox.test(.csf, .ref, paired = TRUE)$p.value)
          else NA_real_,
        .groups = "drop") |>
      dplyr::mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_paired, "BH"),
                    comparison = paste(bnk_csf_comp, "vs", bnk_ref_comp)) |>
      dplyr::arrange(group, p_paired)
    print(as.data.frame(isotype_paired))
    readr::write_csv(isotype_paired,
                     file.path(path$tables_bnk, "bnk_ig_isotype_paired.csv"))
  }
}

if (nrow(isotype_tab)) {
p_bnk_iso <- ggplot(isotype_tab, aes(compartment, pct, group = donor)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = group), size = 2) +
  facet_grid(group ~ isotype) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(control = "grey45", `X-ALD` = "#B2182B"), name = NULL) +
  labs(y = "% of isotype-assigned B cells", x = NULL,
       title = "Isotype distribution, paired CSF vs blood",
       subtitle = "One line = one donor; discordance = not a passive blood sample") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(p_bnk_iso)
ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_bnk, "bnk_ig_isotype_paired.pdf"), p_bnk_iso, width = 10, height = 5)
}
readr::write_csv(isotype_yield, file.path(path$tables_bnk, "bnk_ig_isotype_yield.csv"))
```

#### Readout 2 - enrichment index

```{r bnk-ig-index, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
ig_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(bnk_ig[grep("^B_", names(bnk_ig))], function(o, nm) {
  cl <- bnk_lab_cols[[nm]]
  if (is.na(cl)) { message("  ", nm, ": no label vocabulary recognised"); return(NULL) }
  tibble(compartment = unique(as.character(o$compartment)),
         donor_raw   = as.character(o[[bnk_params$donor_var, drop = TRUE]]),
         group       = as.character(o[[bnk_params$diagnosis_var, drop = TRUE]]),
         label       = as.character(o[[cl, drop = TRUE]]))
})

if (!is.null(ig_long) && nrow(ig_long)) {
  ig_long <- ig_long |>
    dplyr::mutate(donor = sub(BNK_DON_RE, "", donor_raw),
                  class = dplyr::case_when(
                    grepl(PB_PATTERN, label)    ~ "PB",
                    grepl(NAIVE_PATTERN, label) ~ "naive",
                    TRUE ~ NA_character_))
  cat("Label -> class:\n")
  print(as.data.frame(dplyr::count(ig_long, label, class, name = "n_cells")))
}

ig_index <- NULL
if (is.null(ig_long) || !nrow(ig_long) || !any(ig_long$class %in% "PB")) {
  message("Readout 2: no cell matches PB_PATTERN ('", PB_PATTERN, "'). The ",
          "table above lists the labels present -- adjust PB_PATTERN/",
          "NAIVE_PATTERN, or curate 5.8.2.")
} else {
  bnk_per_donor <- ig_long |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(class)) |>
    dplyr::count(compartment, donor, group, class, name = "n") |>
    tidyr::complete(tidyr::nesting(compartment, donor, group),
                    class = c("PB", "naive"), fill = list(n = 0)) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
  for (k in c("PB", "naive")) if (!k %in% names(bnk_per_donor)) bnk_per_donor[[k]] <- 0L

  bnk_per_donor <- bnk_per_donor |>
    dplyr::mutate(ratio = (PB + 0.5) / (naive + 0.5))
  cat("\nCell counts per donor x compartment:\n")
  print(as.data.frame(dplyr::arrange(bnk_per_donor, compartment, donor)))

  bnk_comps_ok <- sort(unique(bnk_per_donor$compartment))
  if (length(bnk_comps_ok) < 2) {
    message("Readout 2: only compartment '", bnk_comps_ok,
            "' present -- the index is a CSF/blood ratio and needs both.")
  } else {
    bnk_csf_comp <- if ("CSF" %in% bnk_comps_ok) "CSF" else bnk_comps_ok[1]
    bnk_ref_comp <- setdiff(bnk_comps_ok, bnk_csf_comp)[1]

    bnk_wide <- bnk_per_donor |>
      dplyr::select(donor, group, compartment, ratio, PB, naive) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = compartment,
                         values_from = c(ratio, PB, naive))
    rc <- paste0("ratio_", bnk_csf_comp); rr <- paste0("ratio_", bnk_ref_comp)
    if (!all(c(rc, rr) %in% names(bnk_wide))) {
      message("Readout 2: columns ", rc, "/", rr, " missing -- no pair.")
    } else {
      ig_index <- bnk_wide |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[rc]]), !is.na(.data[[rr]])) |>
        dplyr::mutate(index = log2(.data[[rc]] / .data[[rr]]),
                      comparison = paste(bnk_csf_comp, "vs", bnk_ref_comp)) |>
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(index))
      if (!nrow(ig_index)) {
        message("Readout 2: no donor with both compartments.")
        ig_index <- NULL
      }
    }
  }
}

if (!is.null(ig_index)) print(as.data.frame(ig_index))
if (!is.null(ig_index))
  readr::write_csv(ig_index, file.path(path$tables_bnk, "bnk_ig_enrichment_index.csv"))

if (!is.null(ig_index) && nrow(ig_index) >= 4) {
  print(stats::wilcox.test(index ~ group, data = ig_index))
  for (g in unique(ig_index$group)) {
    v <- ig_index$index[ig_index$group == g]
    if (length(v) >= 4)
      cat(sprintf("%s: median index %.2f, Wilcoxon vs 0 p = %.3f (n = %d)\n",
                  g, stats::median(v),
                  suppressWarnings(stats::wilcox.test(v, mu = 0)$p.value), length(v)))
  }
}

if (!is.null(ig_index) && nrow(ig_index)) {
p_bnk_index <- ggplot(ig_index, aes(group, index, colour = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey55") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, seed = 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(control = "grey45", `X-ALD` = "#B2182B"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]~"(PB/naive)"[CSF]~"/"~"(PB/naive)"[blood]),
       title = "Plasmablast enrichment in CSF",
       subtitle = "> 0: enriched beyond general B-cell traffic") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
print(p_bnk_index)
ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_bnk, "bnk_ig_enrichment_index.pdf"), p_bnk_index, width = 7, height = 5)
}
```

#### Readouts 3 and 4 - in-situ maturation and light-chain restriction

```{r bnk-ig-insitu}
bnk_insitu <- purrr::imap_dfr(bnk_ig[grep("^B_", names(bnk_ig))], function(o, nm) {
  pb <- grepl(PB_PATTERN, ig_labels_of(o))
  pb[is.na(pb)] <- FALSE
  if (!any(pb)) { message("  ", nm, ": no cell matches PB_PATTERN"); return(NULL) }
  cts <- LayerData(o, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[, pb, drop = FALSE]
  g   <- function(x) intersect(x, rownames(cts))
  tibble(
    subset      = nm,
    compartment = unique(as.character(o$compartment)),
    group       = as.character(o[[bnk_params$diagnosis_var, drop = TRUE]])[pb],
    prolif      = Matrix::colSums(cts[g(c("MKI67", "TOP2A")), , drop = FALSE]) > 0,
    aicda       = Matrix::colSums(cts[g("AICDA"), , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
})

if (!nrow(bnk_insitu) || !all(c("compartment", "group") %in% names(bnk_insitu))) {
  message("Readout 3: no plasmablasts found (PB_PATTERN = '", PB_PATTERN,
          "'). The label -> class table in readout 2 shows the vocabulary.")
} else {
  bnk_insitu <- bnk_insitu |>
    dplyr::group_by(compartment, group) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_PB = dplyr::n(),
                     pct_prolif = round(100 * mean(prolif), 1),
                     pct_aicda  = round(100 * mean(aicda), 1), .groups = "drop")
  print(as.data.frame(bnk_insitu))
  readr::write_csv(bnk_insitu, file.path(path$tables_bnk, "bnk_ig_insitu_plasmablasts.csv"))
}

bnk_light <- purrr::imap_dfr(bnk_ig[grep("^B_", names(bnk_ig))], function(o, nm) {
  keep <- !is.na(o$light_chain) & grepl(PB_PATTERN, ig_labels_of(o))
  keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  tibble(compartment = unique(as.character(o$compartment)),
         donor = sub(BNK_DON_RE, "",
                     as.character(o[[bnk_params$donor_var, drop = TRUE]])[keep]),
         group = as.character(o[[bnk_params$diagnosis_var, drop = TRUE]])[keep],
         lc    = o$light_chain[keep])
})

if (!nrow(bnk_light) || !all(c("compartment", "donor") %in% names(bnk_light))) {
  message("Readout 4: no plasmablasts with an assigned bnk_light chain.")
} else {
  bnk_light <- bnk_light |>
    dplyr::count(compartment, donor, group, lc) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = lc, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
  for (k in c("kappa", "lambda")) if (!k %in% names(bnk_light)) bnk_light[[k]] <- 0L
  bnk_light <- bnk_light |>
    dplyr::mutate(n_PB = kappa + lambda,
                  pct_kappa = round(100 * kappa / n_PB, 1)) |>
    dplyr::filter(n_PB >= 10) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(pct_kappa - 60)))
  if (!nrow(bnk_light)) {
    message("Readout 4: no donor with >= 10 plasmablasts -- no kappa/lambda ratio.")
  } else {
    print(as.data.frame(bnk_light))
    readr::write_csv(bnk_light, file.path(path$tables_bnk, "bnk_ig_light_chain.csv"))
  }
}
```
